content.title: 3 Profitable Stocks Worth Your Attention
content.summary: Companies with solid operating margins have a competitive edge, allowing them to reinvest for sustainable expansion. The best of these businesses balance profitability with reinvestment, setting themselves up for long-term success.

content.title: 1 Small-Cap Stock Worth Your Attention and 2 We Avoid
content.summary: Small-cap stocks can be incredibly lucrative investments because their lack of analyst coverage leads to frequent mispricings. However, these businesses (and their stock prices) often stay small because their subscale operations make it harder to expand their competitive moats.

content.title: 1 Cash-Producing Stock on Our Buy List and 2 We Question
content.summary: A company that generates cash isn’t automatically a winner. Some businesses stockpile cash but fail to reinvest wisely, limiting their ability to expand.

content.title: 1 Russell 2000 Stock Worth Your Attention and 2 We Turn Down
